description: This file contains the implementation of a native Microsoft SQL Server driver for ADODB in PHP, including class definitions for database connection management, query execution, record sets, and metadata retrieval specific to MSSQL databases.
external_files: php's mssql extension functions (e.g., mssql_connect, mssql_query, mssql_fetch_assoc, etc.)

classes.name: ADODB_mssql
classes.description: Main driver class for MSSQL database connection and operations, extending ADOConnection with MSSQL-specific implementations.

classes.name: ADORecordset_mssql
classes.description: Recordset class for handling MSSQL query results, supporting fetch modes and result navigation.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_array_mssql
classes.description: Array-based recordset class for MSSQL dates parsing and timestamp conversion.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves server information such as version and description.

methods.name: IfNull
methods.description: Generates SQL for null value handling using ISNULL.

methods.name: _insertid
methods.description: Fetches the last inserted identity value using SCOPE_IDENTITY.

methods.name: _affectedrows
methods.description: Returns number of rows affected by last operation.

methods.name: CreateSequence
methods.description: Creates a sequence table for generating IDs.

methods.name: GenID
methods.description: Generates and returns a new sequence ID.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Executes query with limit and offset support.

methods.name: SQLDate
methods.description: Formats date columns in SQL string based on input format.

methods.name: BeginTrans
methods.description: Starts a transaction.

methods.name: CommitTrans
methods.description: Commits the current transaction.

methods.name: RollbackTrans
methods.description: Rolls back the current transaction.

methods.name: SetTransactionMode
methods.description: Sets transaction isolation level.

methods.name: RowLock
methods.description: Locks rows in specified table for update.

methods.name: MetaIndexes
methods.description: Retrieves index metadata for a table.

methods.name: MetaForeignKeys
methods.description: Retrieves foreign key metadata for a table.

methods.name: MetaDatabases
methods.description: Lists available databases.

methods.name: MetaPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Retrieves primary key columns for a table.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Lists tables in the database, with optional filtering.

methods.name: SelectDB
methods.description: Selects a specific database.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Retrieves the last error message from MSSQL.

methods.name: ErrorNo
methods.description: Retrieves the last error number.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a non-persistent MSSQL connection.

methods.name: _pconnect
methods.description: Establishes a persistent MSSQL connection.

methods.name: Prepare
methods.description: Prepares an SQL statement for execution, with parameter substitution.

methods.name: PrepareSP
methods.description: Prepares a stored procedure call with mssql_init if supported.

methods.name: Conact
methods.description: Concatenates multiple arguments into a MSSQL expression, casting as VARCHAR.

methods.name: Parameter
methods.description: Binds a PHP variable as a parameter to a stored procedure.

methods.name: UpdateBlob
methods.description: Updates a BLOB or CLOB field in a table.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Executes a query or stored procedure, handling bound parameters.

methods.name: _close
methods.description: Closes the MSSQL connection.

methods.name: UnixDate
methods.description: Converts MSSQL date string to UNIX timestamp.

methods.name: UnixTimeStamp
methods.description: Converts MSSQL date string to UNIX timestamp.
